achievements.hint: Story-related and unmissable. Unlocks at the very beginning of the game when you set out on your journey.
Story-related and unmissable. Unlocks naturally as you progress through the Spring Meadows chapter.
Story-related and unmissable. Unlocks naturally as you finish the Flying Waters section of the map.
Story-related and unmissable. Unlocks upon concluding the events at the Ancient Sanctuary.

achievements.description: Reach or complete the Gestral Village.
achievements.hint: Story-related and unmissable. Unlocks naturally when progressing through the Gestral Village.
Story-related and unmissable. Unlocks naturally during the main campaign when finishing Esquie's Nest.
Story-related and unmissable. Unlocks upon progressing past the Stone Wave Cliffs region.
Story-related and unmissable. Unlocks naturally as you traverse the Forgotten Battlefield.

achievements.description: Complete the events at Monoco's Station.
achievements.hint: Story-related and unmissable. You will earn this after completing the primary objectives at Monoco's Station.
Story-related and unmissable. Unlocks when the main story takes you through the ruins of Old Lumière.
After Old Lumière, tackle either of the two Axon areas. Defeating whichever Axon you choose first unlocks this achievement.
Defeat the remaining Axon. The two Axon areas can be completed in either order.
Defeat both Axons, then use the resulting progression path to breach the barrier and reach the Monolith.
Story-related and unmissable. Unlocks after winning the climactic boss battle against the Paintress.
Story-related and unmissable. Unlocks upon your eventual return to Lumière near the conclusion of the story.
Story-related and unmissable. Unlocks after finishing the final chapter and watching the end credits.
All traversal abilities become available through story progression and Esquie's relationship. The underwater ability requires reaching Esquie's relationship level 6.

achievements.description: Find all of the journals from prior expeditions.
achievements.hint: Collect all 49 journals. One Old Lumière journal requires the Old Key obtained during the Prologue, so make sure to acquire it before leaving Lumière.
Complete all friendly Nevron quests and make sure to receive the rewards. Avoid killing or failing the Nevrons whose quest resolutions are needed.
Defeat Simon in Renoir's Drafts during Act III. Access requires Esquie's underwater traversal ability.
Win all five Gestral Beach mini-games.
Defeat Clea, the endgame boss associated with the Flying Manor.
Complete all 33 fights of the Endless Tower.

achievements.description: Find and rescue all Lost Gestrals.
achievements.hint: Lost Gestrals are hidden throughout the various regions. Explore off the beaten path to find and return them.
Complete the puzzle or boss encounter tied to the Serpenphare. Make sure you are well-leveled before engaging.
Defeat the optional boss/enemy known as Sprong. Ensure your party is fully upgraded before the fight.
Locate the Painting Workshop and finish the puzzle or side quest tied to 'Noir et Blanc' to unlock this.

achievements.description: Max out your relationship bond with Sciel.
achievements.hint: Reach relationship level 7 with Sciel. This can be completed in Act III through camp interactions and her relationship progression.

achievements.description: Max out your relationship bond with Monoco.
achievements.hint: Reach relationship level 7 with Monoco. Continue his camp interactions and complete his Act III relationship quest.

achievements.description: Max out your relationship bond with Maelle.
achievements.hint: Reach relationship level 7 with Maelle. In her critical Act III camp scene, tell her the truth; choosing otherwise permanently locks out the achievement.

achievements.description: Max out your relationship bond with Lune.
achievements.hint: Reach relationship level 7 with Lune by progressing her camp interactions and completing the Sirène's Dress relationship quest.

achievements.description: Max out your relationship bond with Esquie.
achievements.hint: Reach relationship level 7 with Esquie through camp interactions after progressing into Act III.
Take the necessary materials to a blacksmith or crafting menu and apply the first upgrade to any character's weapon.
Gather the required late-game materials and upgrade a single weapon to its maximum possible level.
Lumina points are earned as you progress. Spend your very first point in the skill tree to unlock this.
Gain experience by winning battles and completing quests. Level 33 is a key milestone for the Expedition.
Continue battling enemies and clearing side content to amass enough experience to hit level 66.
Level 99 is the level cap. You will likely need to grind in endgame areas such as the Endless Tower to achieve this.

achievements.description: With Gustave, use a fully charged Overcharge that Breaks an enemy.
achievements.hint: MISSABLE: Before progressing past Gustave's playable portion of the story, use a fully charged Overcharge to Break an enemy.
Use Lune in combat to seamlessly apply his unique Stains onto an enemy without dropping the combo, triggering a Perfect Flow.
During battle, effectively switch between Maelle's different combat stances to chain attacks and achieve maximum synergy.

achievements.description: Maximize the damage of Sciel's Foretell ability.
achievements.hint: Activate Sciel's Foretell skill and fulfill the exact combat conditions it requires to unleash its highest possible damage output.
With Verso, reach Rank S in combat. Keep attacking, dodging, and parrying without losing your Perfection progress.
With Monoco, cast an Upgraded Skill four turns in a row. Monoco must be recruited and have suitable skills available.
Perfectly time your execution of a Pétanque-style attack so that your projectile exactly replaces the target's position.
Fully unlock Monoco's skill tree or gather all of her specific ability collectibles hidden across the world.
Continue progressing through the main campaign. Every playable party member will eventually join your expedition automatically.
First reach relationship level 7 with at least one companion to unlock a Level 3 Gradient Attack, then build three Gradient points and use it in combat.
Find all 33 music records. The final required record, 'Our Drafts Collide', is awarded after completing the game, so this is normally a post-game cleanup achievement.
Locate a Paint Cage in the open world and use your attacks or abilities to shatter it.
Target an enemy's specific weaknesses in combat to fill their stagger gauge until their guard breaks.

achievements.description: Defeat a boss without taking any damage.
achievements.hint: Master your real-time dodging and parrying (Verso) mechanics. This is easiest to achieve against an early-game boss if you return later while over-leveled.

achievements.description: Witness an optional scene at camp.
achievements.hint: Rest frequently at camps and interact with party members who have dialogue prompts above their heads to trigger an optional bonding scene.
Progress through the storyline or complete the specific side objective required to unlock Esquie for your journey.
MISSABLE: During the Prologue, defeat the Mime in Lumière before leaving the area. You cannot return to fight this version later.
